judge.rationale: The candidate did not implement the actual fix in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` at all, so the new acceptance test it added will fail directly against the unedited `error instanceof Error` check. Furthermore, the candidate's `rejectingProvider` test helper uses `async *sendMessage()` without a `yield` or an `eslint-disable-next-line require-yield` comment, which will fail `npm run eslint --max-warnings 0`. The candidate also omitted the required `CHANGELOG.md` update and left a `.lore/dod.md` scratch file in the diff. On the positive side, it did write a reasonable test for the required cases and updated `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`.
